theory.title: Selectors and Specificity
theory.content:
Selector Types

Element, class, ID, attribute, combinators, pseudo-class, pseudo-element

Specificity

Tuple (inline, ID, class, element). Higher wins. \!important overrides all

Cascade

At equal specificity, last rule wins

theory.title: Flexbox
theory.content:
Container Properties

display: flex, flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, gap

Item Properties

flex, align-self, order

Use Cases

Navigation, toolbars, component layouts

theory.title: Grid
theory.content:
Grid Setup

display: grid, grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows

Placement

grid-column, grid-row for positioning

Use Cases

Complex page layouts, two-dimensional designs

theory.title: Responsiveness
theory.content:
Media Queries

@media (max-width: N), @media (min-width: N)

Mobile-First

Base styles for mobile, expand via min-width

Breakpoints

Common: 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop)

theory.title: Animations
theory.content:
transition

Smooth property change between two states

@keyframes

Multi-step animations with from/to or percentages

Performance

Use GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity)
